_doc: Copy to private/personal-terms.json and fill in. Words found on signed-in screenshots (by OCR) and in published text that are pixelated or cut to their first letters. phrases: names and account names (multi-word phrases match in order). contains: substrings inside one word (usernames, handles). patterns: regular expressions for one word. ignore: exact words never masked. exempt: per gateway id, terms that stay readable on that gateway's own page (its brand). keep_chars: letters left visible.
